Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Represents a user's submission of answers to the OMR sheet.

answers.description: JSON string representing user's answers. The keys are question numbers (strings), and values are the selected options (A, B, C, or D).

submittedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the submission was made.

score.description: The calculated score of the submission.

correctCount.description: The number of correct answers in the submission.

incorrectCount.description: The number of incorrect answers in the submission.

attemptedCount.description: The number of attempted questions in the submission.

percentage.description: The overall percentage score of the submission.

setNumber.description: The selected question paper set number.

ExamSection.title: Exam Section
ExamSection.description: Defines a section of an exam, including its name and the number of questions.

name.description: The name of the exam section (e.g., 'Physics').

questionCount.description: The number of questions in this section.

order.description: The display order of the section.

ExamConfig.title: Exam Configuration
ExamConfig.description: Stores the settings for different exam modes.

activeExamType.description: Determines which exam is presented: 'single', 'multi', or 'choice' to let the user decide.

singleSectionQuestionCount.description: Total number of questions for the single-section exam.

numberOfSets.description: The number of question paper sets available for the exams.

definition.description: Stores OMR submissions data. 'submissionId' is the unique ID for each submission.

params.name: submissionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the submission.

definition.description: Stores the sections for the multi-section exam. 'sectionId' is the unique ID for each section.

params.name: sectionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the exam section.

definition.description: Stores the main configuration for the exams. There is only one document with the ID 'main'.

firestore.reasoning:
Given the requirement to store user submissions with associated scores and other metrics, and without user authentication, a straightforward collection structure is proposed.  Since there is no authentication, we'll skip path-based ownership. The submissions will be stored in a top-level `submissions` collection. Authorization Independence isn't applicable here, as there are no access controls. QAPs are supported as `list` operations on the submissions collection don't need filtering, given the absence of user roles or permissions.

Each document within the `submissions` collection will represent a single user's submission, containing all the relevant data (answers, score, timestamps, etc.). The `examSections` collection is added to store the dynamic structure of the exam, managed through an admin panel. It is publicly readable but write access should be restricted. A new singleton document `examConfig/main` is added to store global settings for the exam types.
